## Welcome

This website accompanies the manuscript "*scDiagnostics: diagnostic tools for assessing cell type annotation quality in single-cell RNA-seq data*" (Christidis et al.). 

It provides comprehensive tutorials, analysis code, and reproducible workflows demonstrating how [`scDiagnostics`](https://bioconductor.org/packages/scDiagnostics) can evaluate and diagnose automated cell type annotations across different single-cell technologies and biological contexts.

## Overview

We showcase `scDiagnostics` using two distinct public datasets:

- **COVID-19 PBMC scRNA-seq**: Dense, high-cell-count dataset diagnosing annotations in severe infection vs. healthy controls
- **MERFISH Mouse Colitis**: Spatial transcriptomics dataset evaluating annotations in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD)

For each dataset, we generate annotations using four popular tools:
- [**SingleR**](https://bioconductor.org/packages/SingleR)
- [**Azimuth**](https://github.com/satijalab/azimuth)
- [**CellTypist**](https://www.celltypist.org/)
- [**scVI/scArches**](https://docs.scvi-tools.org/)
